longform.title: Realtime Deep Sea in the Browser — Made with AI (WebGPU, Claude Opus 5.5)
longform.description:
A first-person dive from a boat deck down to the 4,000 m abyssal plain, running in real time in a web browser on a custom WebGPU engine: no game engine, no three.js.
The code, WGSL shaders, Blender model scripts, sound mix and this cinematic were built with AI, using Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) with a human director giving notes.

▶ Play it in your browser (Chrome / Edge with WebGPU, PC or phone): https://daforce1984.github.io/deepsea/
▶ Source code: https://github.com/daforce1984/deepsea

The game runs in real time (24 fps on a GTX 1060 3GB). This 1080p video was captured frame by frame from the same browser build, with its own in-engine audio.

Chapters
0:00 Dive boat
0:30 Humpback breathing & lobtail
1:44 Dolphins
2:22 Manta rays
3:18 Bait ball & tuna
4:12 Humpback close pass
6:08 Sharks
7:20 Oarfish
9:26 Giant turtle
11:38 Megalodon
13:26 Jellyfish
13:54 Headless chicken monster
14:30 Siphonophore
15:22 Giant squid
17:58 Anglerfish
20:42 Abyssal floor

Inside: GPU FFT ocean, 400k-drop whale-tail spray in a compute shader, merging/tearing foam, depth-correct light absorption, torch shadows, HRTF spatial audio.

short60.title: Realtime deep sea in the browser — made with AI 🌊 #Shorts
short60.description:
Dive from the surface to the 4,000 m abyss in one minute: humpback tail slap, mantas, a bait ball, great white, oarfish, megalodon, giant squid, anglerfish.
Everything runs in real time in a web browser on a custom WebGPU engine, built with AI (Claude Code / Claude Opus 5.5).

▶ Full 21-minute dive: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bDdKgf036kY
▶ Play it in your browser (Chrome/Edge, WebGPU): https://daforce1984.github.io/deepsea/
▶ Source: https://github.com/daforce1984/deepsea

Music: the game's own AI-generated ambient cues. Sound effects: Pixabay (Pixabay Content License).
3D models: CC BY 4.0 / CC BY 3.0 / CC0, credited in the full video and the repo (assets/**/SOURCES.txt).
